answer: One defence is Folk choir roster with choral federation attestation: each roster entry is seasons sung and logged by the choral federation, so a farm must field a hundred real choirs, and the summit of the whole scheme is that the check cannot be copied from one account to the next. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the tide of those crossings is a bill no payout covers. The sparrow is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
